skill.description: Generate still images with Google Nano Banana 2 through the local RunComfy CLI. The skill documents model selection, prompt structure, resolution options, web grounding, output formats, and privacy notes for text-to-image workflows.
skill.summary: Create Nano Banana 2 images on RunComfy with guided prompts and CLI options.

security_audit.summary: The skill is transparent documentation for using the RunComfy CLI to generate images with Nano Banana 2. Most static findings are Markdown formatting false positives; the remaining confirmed items are the intended external CLI and outbound API behavior, with no evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or hidden local file access.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution is required for the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples explicit and require normal tool approval before running RunComfy commands.

remediation.issue: Prompts and generated image requests are sent to RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit sensitive prompts or private data unless their RunComfy account and data policy allow it.

remediation.issue: Authentication depends on a local token file or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
remediation.suggestion: Continue documenting token storage permissions and prefer environment variables in CI or container environments.

content.value_statement: Image generation workflows need clear model settings and prompt structure to avoid slow, costly trial and error. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through RunComfy commands for Nano Banana 2 image creation.
actual_capabilities: Routes text-to-image requests to the RunComfy Nano Banana 2 model endpoint.
Documents supported fields including prompt, image count, seed, aspect ratio, resolution, format, and web search.
Provides example CLI invocations for drafts, batches, final images, and web-grounded prompts.
Explains prompt patterns for subjects, typography, seeds, and style constraints.
Lists practical limits such as still images only, four outputs per request, and higher cost for larger resolutions.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.
Submits prompts and generation requests to RunComfy over the network.
Does not edit existing images; it directs users to a separate edit skill.
Generated quality still depends on prompt clarity and model behavior.

use_cases.title: Draft social campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Create several fast 0.5K or 1K image options before selecting one concept for refinement.

use_cases.title: Prepare brand concept cards
use_cases.description: Generate product cards or posters with quoted in-image text, controlled framing, and selected aspect ratios.

use_cases.title: Prototype image prompts in an IDE
use_cases.description: Use Claude Code or Codex to assemble RunComfy CLI calls with repeatable seeds and output directories.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to generate a 1K square PNG of a clean product photo for this concept: [describe product and mood]. Save the result to [output folder].

prompt_templates.title: Create four vertical variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four 9:16 Nano Banana 2 draft images at 0.5K for [campaign idea]. Keep the subject clear and vary composition slightly.

prompt_templates.title: Refine with a fixed seed
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 2K 16:9 Nano Banana 2 image using seed [number]. Preserve the overall composition while improving [lighting, text, or background].

prompt_templates.title: Use web-grounded context
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 with web search enabled to generate an image about [current event or real entity]. Keep the prompt factual and save one PNG output.

output_examples.input: Generate a square product image for a matte black mug with the words Brewed Quietly.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares a RunComfy Nano Banana 2 request with a quoted typography prompt, 1K resolution, PNG output, and a chosen output folder.

output_examples.input: Make four vertical wellness brand images for social media.
output: The request uses four images at draft resolution.
The prompt keeps the subject, lighting, and brand mood explicit.

output_examples.input: Create a current-event image that uses recent real-world context.
output_examples.output: The assistant enables web search for the RunComfy request and explains that it may add cost and latency.

best_practices: Start prompts with the main subject, then add environment, style, camera, and output constraints.
Quote any in-image text exactly and describe its placement and font style.
Use low resolution for exploration, then increase resolution only for final candidates.
anti_patterns: Do not request unsupported aspect ratios or custom resolution values outside the documented tiers.
Do not enable web search unless the prompt needs current information or real entity context.
Do not use this text-to-image endpoint for image editing or subject identity preservation.

faq.question: Does this skill generate images locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit requests to the RunComfy model API.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it create more than four images at once?
faq.answer: No. The documented endpoint supports a maximum of four outputs per request.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: No. The skill points users to a sibling edit skill for image editing workflows.

faq.question: When should web search be enabled?
faq.answer: Enable it only when the prompt needs current events or real-world entity context.

faq.question: Where does authentication come from?
faq.answer: The skill expects RunComfy login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable for CI and containers.
